D: A primary school teacher accidentally promises that Hollywood is coming to see his school's nativity play.
P: Serve the sweets when the nativity play starts.
S: Shortcrust fruit mince pies with star tops

Buttery mince pies with crumbly star lids, dusted with icing sugar and served warm with orange-scented whipped cream. Cut 12 rounds from 2 sheets shortcrust pastry and press into a greased patty pan tin. Fill each with 1 heaped tbsp fruit mince from a 400g jar. Cut 12 stars from a third sheet and lay on top. Brush with beaten egg and bake at 190C for 18 minutes until golden. Whip 200ml thickened cream with 1 tbsp icing sugar and the zest of 1 orange. Dust the pies with icing sugar and serve warm with the cream.
Christmas fair pork and apple rolls
Pork, apple and sage sausage rolls in puff pastry

Golden puff pastry rolls of pork, apple and sage, glazed with egg and sprinkled with seeds, with a tangy tomato relish for dipping. Mix 500g pork sausage mince with 1 grated apple, 1 grated onion, 2 tbsp chopped sage and 30g breadcrumbs. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry in half, lay a log of filling along each and roll up, sealing underneath. Brush with beaten egg, sprinkle with 1 tbsp sesame seeds and cut each into 4. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden. Serve with 200g tomato relish.
M: Roast chicken, pigs in blankets, roast potatoes, maple sprouts, gravy

Roast chicken with pigs in blankets, crunchy roast potatoes, maple-glazed Brussels sprouts with bacon and plenty of gravy. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with butter and salt and roast at 200C for 1 hour 15 minutes. Wrap 12 chipolatas in half rashers of streaky bacon and add for the last 30 minutes. Roast 1kg parboiled potatoes in oil for 50 minutes. Halve 400g Brussels sprouts and fry with 2 diced rashers bacon for 6 minutes, then toss with 1 tbsp maple syrup. Make gravy from the pan juices with 1 tbsp flour and 350ml chicken stock.
W: Christmas pudding, vanilla ice cream, custard, toffee sauce and honeycomb

Warm crumbled Christmas pudding layered with vanilla ice cream, custard, toffee sauce and crushed honeycomb in tall sundae glasses. Warm an 800g Christmas pudding in the microwave or steamer as the packet says, then break half of it into chunks. Warm 300ml thick vanilla custard. In 4 sundae glasses, layer pudding chunks, a scoop of vanilla ice cream, a spoon of custard and a drizzle of toffee sauce, then repeat. Finish with whipped cream from 150ml thickened cream and 40g crushed honeycomb.
K: Hot apple juice and blackcurrant cordial with cinnamon, clove and ginger

Blackcurrant cordial warmed with cloudy apple juice, cinnamon, orange and ginger, served steaming in mugs for the kids. Pour 1L cloudy apple juice and 400ml water into a saucepan with 150ml blackcurrant cordial, 2 cinnamon sticks, 4 cloves, 2 slices fresh ginger and 1 sliced orange. Heat gently for 10 minutes without boiling. Strain into 4 mugs and add an orange slice to each.

veg.n: Christmas fair lentil and apple rolls
veg.make_ahead: Make the lentil filling up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; roll, glaze and bake on the day

ingredients.item: eggs (1 for the filling, 1 beaten for glazing)

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in the oil until dry and golden, then cool.
Lightly mash the lentils and mix with the mushrooms, apple, onion, sage, breadcrumbs, one egg and salt.
Cut the pastry in half, lay a log of filling along each strip, roll up and seal underneath.
Brush with the other egg, sprinkle with sesame seeds and cut into pieces.
Bake at 200C until golden. Serve with relish.

dishes.make_ahead: Rub the chicken with butter and salt and parboil the potatoes up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; roast on the day and make the gravy from the pan juices

ingredients.item: rashers streaky bacon (8 to wrap, 4 to fry)

steps.text: Rub the chicken with butter and salt.
Roast at 200C.
Wrap the chipolatas in half rashers of bacon and add for the last part of the roasting.
Roast the parboiled potatoes in oil.
Fry the sprouts with diced bacon, then toss with maple syrup.
Make gravy from the pan juices with the flour and stock.

veg.make_ahead: Mix and press the nut roast into its tin up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; roast on the day with the potatoes and cook the sprouts fresh

ingredients.item: mushrooms, finely chopped (300g for the roast, 100g for the sprouts)

steps.text: Fry the onion and 300g of the mushrooms in the butter until dry, then mix with the nuts, lentils, breadcrumbs, eggs, cheddar and thyme and press into a lined loaf tin.
Roast the nut roast, and the parboiled potatoes in 2 tbsp of the oil, at 200C for 50 minutes.
Toss the chipolatas with 1 tbsp of the maple syrup and the smoked paprika and add to the oven for the last 20 minutes.
Fry the sprouts in the rest of the oil with the remaining 100g of mushrooms until browned and smoky, then toss with the rest of the maple syrup.
Whisk the flour into the potato tray juices, add the stock and soy sauce and simmer into gravy. Rest the nut roast 10 minutes, slice and serve.
